en: "I-it went in...?{w}YEEEAAAHHH, HELL YEAH!!"{w}{p}"Lucky punks, I'll let you off today!!{w}See ya, so long!!"{w}
note: The doll is the golfer and the party is the "ball" (3228/3074 pun), so it cheers its own birdie putt sinking, then lets the party go. yatsu me read as the party (plural).

en: The Clown Doll crumpled to the floor, as if all its moving until now had been a lie, and didn't so much as twitch.{w}

As you walked through the bunker, a sudden dizziness came over you.{w}But sand or no sand, this was no desert -- there was no reason for you to feel dizzy.{w}{p}Looking around, you saw the scenery warped.{w}That dizziness just now had come from stepping into a distortion in space!{w}{p}You knew you had to get out fast, but inside the warped space you couldn't move the way you wanted.{w}Before long, the one who had created the distortion appeared.{w}
It didn't seem to have much power, but its seasoned bearing was more than enough to fill a foe with dread.{w}
You routed the Outer Demon.{w}
note: Outer Demon = new name (monster, not in glossary).

en: Then the distortion around the Outer Demon grew violent and carried it off to a land infinitely far away.{w}
As you stood there dumbfounded, you spotted the Clown Doll over by the green, looking for you...{w}
That's right -- you were still in the middle of a round of golf!{w}
A beastfolk girl is sadly digging at the ground with a knife.{w}{p}When she notices you, she totters over, as if clinging to you for help.{w}
note: Glossary title Beastfolk Girl; lowercase in narration.

en: Beastfolk Girl
"Um, I... I have a grandma who's sick..."{w}{p}"She could go any day now...{w}*sob*... And to save her...{w}the doctor said the only way is to play golf..."{w}
note: sensei read as the doctor treating the grandmother.

en: "Will you please golf with me?"
note: Yes/no prompt; kept near 30 chars.

en: The beastfolk girl muttered a small "Tch," and went back to digging at the ground.{w}

"BOOOO!{w}It was meeee all alooong~~~!!"{w}{p}"From here on, I make the rules.{w}And you can't go against 'em, got it?"{w}{p}"Oh yeah, right. Forgot to mention!{w}The 'balls' in this game are you lot!{w}GYAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!"{w}{p}"Now then, on toward the hole at south-center!{w}Time for the first stroke!"{w}
note: The beastfolk girl was the Clown Doll in disguise. Pages 2-4 repeat SCD07:3074 (slice 041) word for word in the source; align the two renderings. tama = ball, with a crude double meaning; "balls" keeps both.

en: Sentry

"You want to go up to the next floor?{w}Heh heh heh. If we press the switch at the back, the gate opens and you can pass."{w}{p}"But you see, lately...{w}our pockets have been feeling a bit empty... you know?"{w}{p}"You came here to play with a pile of money, didn't you?{w}In that case... how about sparing a little something for us... eh!!"{w}
note: Whose pockets is unstated; "our" follows watashitachi / watakushidomo in the same speech.

en: "I-I'm so sorry!{w}P-p-please, just spare my liiife!!"{w}
The sentry ran away.{w}
note: Glossary title Sentry; lowercase in narration.

en: Organizer
"There's an arena over here, too!"{w}{p}"Just how far will your strength get you against Professor Rombino?{w}Anyone who wants in, step up one at a time!!"{w}
Will you enter?
"Hahaha, they're scared!{w}Scared of Professor Rombino's adorable little looooks!!"{w}
note: Third-person mockery of the party (bibitte yagaru), likely played to the onlookers.

en: "And by the way, these are the winners from last time!"{w}
"All right, go on in, one at a time!!{w}Give it all you've got -- GO!"{w}
"Whoa, you're pretty damn good!{w}You won -- you're the champ, the CHAMP!!"{w}

"Fuhahahaha!
That's nowhere near good enough!"{w}{p}"Don't you go underestimating Professor Rombino!"{w}
"Come back and play again sometime!"{w}
As you were about to leave, Professor Rombino was chewing away right in front of you.{w}{p}Something stick-shaped was poking out of Professor Rombino's mouth.{w}
note: Rombino's gender is unknown; name repeated instead of a pronoun.

en: Prof. Rombino
note: Glossary note: name box "Prof. Rombino" (Elm3).

en: "Gyuuu"{w}
note: Creature noise (gyuu, a squeeze/squeal); romanized, meaning unclear without the choice that leads here.

en: "Buuu"{w}
note: Creature noise (buu, a pouting boo); romanized. Leads to Rombino leaving.

en: Professor Rombino went away.{w}
"Guri-guri-guri-guri-guri-guri..."{w}
note: guri-guri = grinding/nuzzling sound; romanized.

en: Professor Rombino went away, looking displeased.{w}
Arena Manager
"Well, well, a walk-in challenger?"{w}{p}"This arena welcomes walk-in entrants with open arms!{w}The winner's prize is 400,000 GP!{w}Why not join in and earn yourself a little pocket money?"{w}
"Oh dear? Now's not a good time?{w}I see. Well, come back again sometime! I'll be waiting!!"{w}
"Then let's have the name of your representative."{w}
Who will give their name?

"{0A:0003:001C}, is it?{w}Right, got it."{w}{p}"Enemies will come out five times, and if you beat every last one of them, you win.{w}Simple, right?"{w}{p}"Only, Heerdahl has a rule, you see.{w}By 'beat'... I mean kill. You understand, right?"{w}{p}"Don't go telling me you're scared now, okay?{w}There's a big crowd waiting!{w}HEEEEE-HEE-HEE-HEE!!"{w}{p}"If you're lucky enough to catch Mistress's eye, even more prizes await you!{w}Now, fight like your life depends on it!!"{w}{p}"And now, Round 1... BEGIN!!"{w}
note: Source writes shouhin (goods) for shouhin (prize); read as "prizes". {0A} = the representative's name.

en: "That's the match!{w}The winner: {0A:0003:001C}!"{w}{p}"Well, if you didn't win at least once, you couldn't even die in peace, could you?{w}Hee hee hee!!"{w}{p}"Next up, Round 2... BEGIN!!"{w}

"That's the match!{w}The winner: {0A:0003:001C}!{w}You sure are hard to kill!"{w}{p}"Want to survive that badly, do you?{w}Living a long life won't bring you a single good thing!{w}Hee hee hee!"{w}{p}"Next up, Round 3... BEGIN!!"{w}

"That's the match!{w}The winner: {0A:0003:001C}!{w}...You lot, it's about time you read the room, okay?"{w}{p}"This arena has no use for heroes who keep on winning.{w}What we want to see is how people die! Hee hee hee!"{w}{p}"Next up, Round 4... BEGIN!!"{w}
"That's the match!{w}The winner: {0A:0003:001C}!{w}...Just hurry up and croak already."{w}{p}"Next up, Round 5... BEGIN!!"{w}
"That's the match!{w}The champion: {0A:0003:001C}!"{w}
At once, disgruntled voices erupted from the stands!{w}

"Ah, ladies and gentlemen! My deepest apologies!!{w}These things do happen, I suppose.{w}Rules are rules, so we will hand over the prize money."{w}{p}"...However.{w}They have not yet paid their entry fee."{w}{p}"Walk-ins are welcome... but...{w}we never said entry was free.{w}The entry fee is... 399,500 GP!!"{w}
note: Addressed to the audience (minasama).

en: Cheers and laughter rang out from the stands!!{w}
"And so, the winner's prize is yours.{w}Here you are..."{w}
"Now then, we'll collect that entry fee."{w}
"That leaves you with 500 GP!{w}Go eat something tasty with it on your way home!!{w}HEEEE-HEE-HEE-HEE!!"{w}

"That's the match!{w}The winner: {0A:0003:001C}!{w}...Just hurry up and croak already."{w}{p}"Next up, Round 5... Hm?{w}Hey, what's the holdup? Where's the next opponent!?{w}The audience is waiting!!"{w}
It seems the next contestant doesn't want to fight.{w}
"Geez, you lot kept winning, and now your opponent's lost their nerve.{w}Tch!!"{w}
note: Opponent is Gregorio, but not yet revealed; "their" kept.

en: "Don't screw with meeee!{w}Killin' people? There's no way, dammiiiit!"{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Gregorio (named two rows later). Gregorio's stretched-vowel voice from slice 020.

en: It's a voice you've heard before!!{w}
"'Don't go makin' trouble for other folks!'{w}That's what Ma taught meeee!!"{w}
note: kaachan = "Ma", as in slice 020.

en: "Ahaha, you get one every so often -- somebody who signs up without listening properly to the killing rule,{w}then kicks up a big fuss."{w}{p}"The customers of this arena just love contestants like that.{w}Well, well, what kind of whining will we get to hear!"{w}{p}"HEEEEE-HEE-HEE-HEE!!"{w}
"I'm quittiiing!{w}I ain't doin' this, nooo waaay!!"{w}
"I'm afraid that is not possible.{w}You have already signed a contract with our arena, after all."{w}{p}"Come, come, your opponent is waiting."{w}
note: anata-sama: polite "you"; no "sir" (gender not inferred from the honorific).

en: "I-I was gonna win the prize moneyyy{w}and get Ma a new oven mitt..."{w}{p}"Huh, you punks!?{w}We met back in Saimar, didn't we? Yeaaah!{w}Long time no seeee!!"{w}
note: nabetsukami = pot holder / oven mitt. temeera = "you punks" (his crude address, friendly tone here). tashika = "didn't we?"

en: "Oho, now this is unexpected.{w}Why, it seems these two know each other!"{w}
note: Announced to the crowd; "these two" = Gregorio and the party's representative (karera = they).

en: The stands went wild in an instant!!{w}
"Heeeey!{w}These people are nuts, maaan!!{w}Let's quit this fightin' stuuuff!!"{w}
note: koitsura read as the crowd and the arena staff, not the party.

en: "Oh my, I won't allow any such thing, you know?"{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Mistress (greeted two rows later).

en: "Well, well, if it isn't Mistress!{w}Welcome, so good of you to come!{w}Hee hee hee!!"{w}
"You two know each other?{w}Then I simply must have you fight!"{w}{p}"But the prize money as it stands isn't enough for you, is it?{w}So as an extra prize, I'll gi-ve you this!"{w}
note: a-ge-ru spelled out teasingly -> "gi-ve". anatatachi = the two fighters.

en: "Ohh, that's Belfana!{w}The very mace Mistress is said to love using!!"{w}
note: Belfana = new item name (ITEM.CSV:440, untranslated); romanized.

en: "This one's well broken in, you know.{w}You want it, don't you?{w}I'll give it to whichever of you fights and survives!!"{w}
The excitement in the stands reached fever pitch!!{w}
"Noooo!{w}I don't wanna kill nobody, noooo!"{w}{p}"Let's quit, huh? Let's ditch this and go find some more peaceful work together, yeaaah!?"{w}
Will you fight?
The cheering in the stands turned into disgruntled voices!!{w}
"What is this?{w}How boring..."{w}
The stands were engulfed in disgruntled voices!!{w}
"Phew, thank goodneeess!{w}Next time I'm gonna find a better joooob!!{w}Bye-byeeeee!!"{w}
"You... you threw cold water on the whole thing...{w}You've gone and ruined our show!{w}Enough -- get the hell out of here!!"{w}
note: tonda mizuiri (sumo: a bout halted midway) rendered as "threw cold water on". kisama = harsh "you".

en: "Wh-- no waaay!?{w}This can't be happeniiing!!{w}I don't wanna kill anybody, maaan!!"{w}
"Hahaha, then just die!"{w}
note: Likely to Gregorio, who refuses to fight.

en: "Wonderful!{w}Friends killing each other!{w}Ah, what a life -- one that can never be undone!!"{w}
note: torikaeshi no tsukanai jinsei: the survivor's life is now beyond undoing; kept close to literal.
